name: @qorechain/mcp

tools.name: get_chain_info
tools.description: Read the current state of a QoreChain network (mainnet or testnet): chain ids, latest and earliest available block, minimum gas price, the sign-bytes version for the hybrid ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) signature layer, protocol feature switches, a pending upgrade if one is scheduled, and the active EVM precompiles. The PQC precompiles 0x...0A01 and 0x...0A02 are active on testnet only. Read-only; uses the public REST, RPC and EVM endpoints.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: Read one block of a QoreChain network (mainnet or testnet) by height, or the latest block: hash, time, proposer, transaction count and up to 100 transaction hashes. Testnet nodes prune old blocks; a pruned height returns NOT_FOUND with the lowest available height. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

height.description: Block height. Omit for the latest block.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Read a committed QoreChain transaction (mainnet or testnet) by its native hash, or by its EVM hash (0x prefix). Returns status, fee, memo, gas, up to 50 messages with their main fields, the signers, and the signature tier: "pqc" (hybrid secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) signature), "enrollment" (registers an ML-DSA-87 key), "shake" (native lane without the ML-DSA-87 layer) or "classical" (EVM lane). To check that the ML-DSA-87 layer verifies, use get_pq_status. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

hash.description: Transaction hash: 64 hex characters, or 0x + 64 hex for an EVM transaction hash.

tools.name: get_address_info
tools.description: Read a QoreChain account (mainnet or testnet) from a qor1... or 0x... address: both address forms, whether the account exists, account number and sequence, up to 100 balances (uqor shown in QOR too, 1 QOR = 10^6 uqor), staked amount, whether an ML-DSA-87 key is registered, and whether EVM bytecode is deployed there. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

address.description: qor1... account address or 0x... address (40 hex characters).

tools.name: get_pq_status
tools.description: Hybrid ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) status on QoreChain (mainnet or testnet). For an address (qor1... or 0x...): whether a key is registered, its algorithm and key type, whether possession was proven, and the EVM authorization window. For a transaction hash: whether the body carries exactly one /qorechain.pqc.v1.PQCHybridSignature layer, the signature tier, and whether the layer verifies locally against the signer's registered key (sign-bytes v1 or v2). The EVM precompiles 0x...0A01 and 0x...0A02 are active on testnet only. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

target.description: qor1... or 0x... address (40 hex), or a transaction hash (64 hex, or 0x + 64 hex for an EVM hash).

tools.name: get_validators
tools.description: List validators of a QoreChain network (mainnet or testnet), sorted by stake: operator address, moniker, status, jailed flag, stake in uqor and QOR, voting power share and commission. Default: bonded validators, at most 50 (limit up to 200). Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

tools.name: get_staking_tiers
tools.description: Read the staking tier module of a QoreChain network (mainnet or testnet, chain v3.2.4 and later): lock terms (3, 6 or 12 months) and their bonus in basis points, light node and validator bonuses, the yield cap, the early unlock penalty, the bonus pool, and optionally one holder's locks and claimable bonus. Amounts in uqor. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

holder.description: qor1... or 0x... address whose locks to read.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Look up anything on a QoreChain network (mainnet or testnet) from one string: a block height, a transaction hash (native, or 0x + 64 hex for an EVM hash), a qor1... or 0x... address, or a qorvaloper1... validator. Detects the kind, reads it, and names the tool that returns the same data. Read-only.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

query.description: Block height, transaction hash, address or validator operator address.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call a view function of an EVM contract on QoreChain (mainnet chain id 9801 or testnet 9800) with eth_call only: nothing is signed or sent and no state can change. Pass raw calldata in data, or a function signature such as "balanceOf(address)" with args; add returns such as ["uint256"] to decode the result (static types, string and bytes). The PQC precompiles 0x...0A01 (ML-DSA-87 verify) and 0x...0A02 (key status) are active on testnet only; on mainnet they return empty data.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

to.description: Contract address, 0x... (a qor1... address is converted).

args.description: Arguments for function. Integers as decimal strings.

from.description: Optional caller address (msg.sender for the call).

tools.name: estimate_fee
tools.description: Estimate the fee of a QoreChain native-lane transaction (mainnet or testnet): simulate it, take the suggested gas limit and multiply by the network's minimum gas price (fee = gas limit x price, in uqor). Pass either an encoded transaction or a simple transfer. The estimate includes the hybrid ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) layer. Nothing is signed or broadcast.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

tx_base64.description: Encoded TxRaw in base64 (signed or unsigned), e.g. unsigned_tx_base64 from prepare_transfer.

transfer.description: A transfer to estimate instead of tx_base64.

tools.name: simulate_tx
tools.description: Simulate an encoded QoreChain native-lane transaction (mainnet or testnet) without broadcasting it. Returns gas used, the gas limit to sign with (exact rule from chain v3.2.5, with a margin on older chains), the balance change per address, and a decoded refusal when the network would reject it. Nothing is signed or broadcast.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

tx_base64.description: Encoded TxRaw in base64 (signed or unsigned), e.g. unsigned_tx_base64 from prepare_transfer.

assume_pqc_layer.description: Default true: when the body has no ML-DSA-87 layer, simulate with a placeholder layer of the right size so the gas includes the layer the wallet adds when signing. The placeholder is never broadcast.

tools.name: prepare_transfer
tools.description: Build an UNSIGNED QoreChain native-lane transfer (MsgSend of uqor) for the sender's own wallet to review and sign. Default network: testnet; pass network "mainnet" explicitly for mainnet. Reads the sender's account number, sequence and public key, simulates to set the gas limit (including the hybrid ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) layer), and returns the SignDoc, a readable summary and checks. The server never signs, never holds keys and never broadcasts.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

amount.description: "1.5" or "1.5 QOR" (QOR, up to 6 decimals) or "1500000uqor".

memo.description: Optional memo, at most 256 characters. Never put secrets in a memo: it is public.

gas_limit.description: Override the simulated gas limit (50000 to 10000000).

tools.name: get_token_holders
tools.description: Not available: listing the holders of a token needs an indexer, and the public QoreChain endpoints do not provide one. Always returns NOT_AVAILABLE_ON_CHAIN. To read one account's balances use get_address_info; to browse, use the explorer at https://explore.qore.network.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

tools.name: request_faucet
tools.description: Not available through this server: testnet QOR comes from the faucet on the QoreChain dashboard, which needs the user to sign in (https://dashboard.qorechain.io/faucet). There is no mainnet faucet. Always returns NOT_AVAILABLE_ON_CHAIN with the faucet link.

network.description: "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi) or "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana). Default: testnet, unless the server is configured otherwise.

instructions: Read access to QoreChain. Every tool takes an optional network: "testnet" (chain qorechain-diana, the default) or "mainnet" (chain qorechain-vladi); pass network "mainnet" explicitly to read mainnet. Amounts are in uqor (1 QOR = 10^6 uqor). Native-lane transactions carry a hybrid secp256k1 + ML-DSA-87 (FIPS 204) signature; get_pq_status checks it. The server never signs, never holds keys and never broadcasts: prepare_transfer returns an unsigned document for the user's own wallet. Never send a recovery phrase or private key to any tool. Errors carry a stable code: NOT_FOUND, INVALID_INPUT, UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE, NOT_AVAILABLE_ON_CHAIN, RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, INTERNAL_ERROR.
